authority: OE14 estimates and OE16 natural-material reference/material comparison authorization; no production or fit authority
scope: 25 exact material entries: all 15 round-1 intact botanical oil identities, pictured oils, bounded common additions, separate Camellia species and C8/C10 MCT. Not an exhaustive list of natural oils.
matching: Trim and collapse whitespace, compare case-insensitively against only canonical_inci and listed aliases. Retain parentheses and plant-part/form words. A documented exact-product display normalization is a separate receipt, never a new generic alias.
interpretation: Rough material priors for equal modest leave-on comparisons near ordinary room temperature; no dose instruction, measured cutoff, efficacy, concentration, user eligibility or zero-residue implication. Use full-formula overlay before emitting product weight.
evidence_ceiling: No entry established a standardized validated hair-weight class. Supplier skin sensory, material behavior and limited generic hair-use descriptions inform authorized approximate priors; confidence means classification robustness.

UNIVAR2018.title: EarthOil / EBInnov sensory profile study

RELE2003.title: Effect of mineral, sunflower and coconut oils on prevention of hair damage
RELE2003.access: PubMed abstract read; full protocol not accessed.

KEIS2005.title: Investigation of penetration abilities of oils into human hair fibers
KEIS2005.access: PubMed abstract read; full protocol not accessed.

KEIS2005.limits: Mechanistic laboratory endpoint, not standardized perceived heaviness; dose, heat and elapsed time matter.
